info.description: Tests for the gateway (service A on :8080) that forwards to service B. Run the whole collection with Collection Runner. It logs in as nithin, alice and a read-only nithin token automatically, then checks auth, ownership, error mapping and scopes. Start the auth server, service B and service A first (dev profile).
info.name: Payment Service A - Automated

item.name: Service A is up (401 without a token)
N-1 Logout page (clears any old session)

exec: pm.test('logged out (302) or nothing to log out', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([302, 403]));

item.name: N-6 Authorize again (consent page or code)

exec: // Either the server redirects straight back with a code (consent already given),
// or it shows the consent page (200) that we must submit in the next request.
pm.collectionVariables.set('consentState', '');   // nothing to submit, so the consent request skips itself
pm.test('code received without consent page', () => pm.expect(code[1]).to.not.be.empty);
// Nothing to submit when the previous step already returned a code (consent was given earlier).
try { pm.execution.skipRequest(); } catch (e) { /* older Postman: request is sent anyway; its test is skipped below */ }
pm.test.skip('consent already given - nothing to submit');
pm.test('token has read and write scope', () => pm.expect(sc).to.include.members(['payment.read', 'payment.write']));

item.name: 5 nithin lists via A -> contains it
6 alice gets nithin's payment via A -> 404

exec: // Ownership must survive the hop through A. A should map B's 404 to a 404 (not a 500).

item.name: 7 alice lists via A -> does not contain it

exec: pm.test('list does not contain nithin''s payment', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(p => p.paymentId)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentId')));
pm.test('409 from B passed through A', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
pm.test('400 from B passed through A', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test('200 - payment.read is enough to read', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('sees its own payment (same user)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(p => p.paymentId)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentId')));

pm.test.skip('B is up - stop service B (port 8081) and re-run this request');
